title: FinalApprovalGranted
description: Raised when the configured final stage approves. Single consumer: the promotion worker. Delivery: exactly-once effect via ops.PromotionLedger, whose IdempotencyKey is UNIQUE - a retried promotion finds the existing row and stops (TAD 8.5).

stagedSha256.description: The published hash must equal this value or the promotion is quarantined rather than completed.
